note: Operational metadata for P0 sources. Joins datasets/catalog.json on `id`. catalog.json answers what a source is and how to get it; this file answers who owns it, how often it changes, how it is refreshed, and when it is stale. Sources outside P0 are inventory-only until promoted — absent here means not yet operated, not exempt.

field_reference.owner: Named person accountable for the source. `unassigned` is honest and actionable; a wrong name is neither.
field_reference.grain: One row of the landed artifact.
field_reference.publisher_cadence: How often the publisher updates. Observed from the publisher, not chosen by us.
field_reference.refresh_mode: full = re-fetch whole artifact. incremental = fetch only new partitions.
field_reference.refresh_trigger: manual until a scheduler exists. Stated so nobody assumes automation.
field_reference.retention: How many releases of the raw artifact to keep. Raw artifacts are never overwritten (ingest README, Revisions).
field_reference.freshness_sla_hours: Age past which the source is stale and must not back a displayed number. null = static source, cannot go stale.
field_reference.backfill: safe = re-running any prior window is idempotent. bounded = only the stated window is re-fetchable. none = publisher serves current state only; history is whatever we already captured.

sources.note: Version is load-bearing: the current TAMU bundle and the June-2016 xlsx are different cases. Pin the release.
Vintage changes county geometry and occasionally FIPS. Never mix vintages in one join.
Revision window means a hour re-fetched later can legitimately differ. Keep source_release; do not treat a change as corruption.
Historical archive, not a live feed. Null is not-reported, never zero customers out.
Cloud archive is large. Fetch only the declared demo windows; a full pull is out of scope.
Events are added retroactively. A window fetched today is not final.
Report retention on the publisher side is limited. What is not captured in the window is not recoverable later.
Public boundary data only. Presence in this file is not a protection or criticality claim.
